name: whatsapp_verified_identities
description: Current proof associating a signed WhatsApp sender with a GLPI identity.
lifecycle: Each sender can verify independently for the same GLPI user. A new proof issues a fresh link ID. Proof expires after thirty days or on administrative revocation.

columns.Meaning: Stable hash of the business phone ID and preferred sender identity.
GLPI directory identity established by mailbox verification or a matching directory phone.
Time the current proof was recorded.
Time after which the link cannot authorize work.
Opaque administrative identifier for the current verification. Changes on re-verification to fence stale actions.
Last four digits of the number supplied by a signed WhatsApp message.
columns.Null meaning: Meta did not supply a phone number or no eligible historical message was retained.

columns.Meaning: Time at which IT revoked this verification.
Verified administration principal that first revoked the current link.
columns.Null meaning: The current verification has no administrative revocation.

constraints.Purpose: Allows only a four-digit display suffix.
Maintains one current verified GLPI identity for a WhatsApp sender scope.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_by IS NULL)) OR ((revoked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (revoked_by IS NOT NULL) AND (revoked_at >= verified_at))))
constraints.Purpose: Requires an attributable and chronologically valid revocation.
Requires a positive GLPI directory identity.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whatsapp_verified_identities_link_id_key ON public.whatsapp_verified_identities USING btree (link_id)
constraints.Purpose: Identifies each current verification with an opaque unique identifier.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_verified_identities_user_links_idx ON public.whatsapp_verified_identities USING btree (glpi_user_id, link_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds each independently verified WhatsApp sender associated with a GLPI user.
